description: MCP server for RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative: 38 tools to manage apps, products, offerings and customers from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.
rules: The hosted MCP server is https://mcp.revenuedot.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP); the client signs in with OAuth, or send `Authorization: Bearer sk_...`.
To run it locally over stdio: `npx -y @revenuedot/mcp` with REVENUEDOT_API_KEY set, and REVENUEDOT_URL for a self-hosted server (it defaults to https://api.revenuedot.app).
No tool accepts a store key or password: App Store and Google Play credentials are entered in the RevenueDot dashboard, and a secret key should carry only the scopes the assistant needs.
Every tool takes an optional `project_id`; leave it out when the key or connection has one project.
The tool definitions can be reused without MCP: `import { tools, runTool } from "@revenuedot/mcp/tools"`.
